editorialCorrections.change: Kept contact/droplet/air examples as textbook classification, never exclusive transmission claims. Risk-based PPE confirmed with MHLW 2023print21–22/PDF24–25; not every care task automatically uses every PPE item.
Principles do not authorize manual lifting. MHLW current official publication of2013guidance supports prioritizing suitable aids for fully dependent transfers.

Retained the medical-device outage scenario as individual planning only. Read current Yokohama official HTML on preparing in advance for users of electrically powered medical devices. Linked district PDF later returned404, so no full district PDF review claimed. No oxygen flow, setup or switching protocol authored.
Kept adult respectful style; cultural tendencies and nodding do not replace personal preference or informed agreement.
